---
title: "09 — Species by exact and near match"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

The benchmark measures taxonomic assignment as a whole; its primary
endpoints are F1 and PPV at **Genus** (OD 43). Species gets this chapter of
its own, because a species name read from a bootstrap classifier at its
threshold is not what a careful user would publish: a species is named here
only when the query is found **at 100 %** in a reference record. Three
methods do that (`pipelines/species.R`, project `species`):

- `dada2::assignSpecies()` on `species_format/` (records naming a species
  only), which accepts a query found as an exact substring of a record;
- vsearch `--usearch_global --id 1 --query_cov 1 --maxaccepts 0
  --maxrejects 32` on the sintax files, a hit kept only when the query is an
  exact substring of the record (vsearch counts a base against an ambiguity
  code as identical);
- blastn, from a search of its own (megablast, up to 2 000 records per
  query), the pairs with no difference over the whole query; until
  2026-10-07 it read the raw tables of the main grid, which keep 500 hits
  per query and no alignment coordinates.

**From exact hits to a species call** (developer, 2026-10-07, OD 43): a query
is named a species when every exact hit that names a species gives the same
binomial; hits naming no species ("sp.", no epithet) do not block the call;
several binomials give no species.

**Near matches** (developer, 2026-10-07, OD 43; section S6): does F1 rise
much once the match is loosened? vsearch and blastn (assignSpecies has no
such mode) also read two relaxations: **at most one difference** over the
whole query, and **100 % identity over at least 90 % of the query, the
record stopping early**: the rest of the query lies beyond an end of the
record (a record shorter than the ITSx region), not against different
bases. Each search proposes (query, record) pairs; whether a pair
passes is decided from the two sequences, the same way for both methods
(`R/species_exact.R`, `near_hit_columns()`). Same call rule at each level.

**What to expect.** Exact matching names fewer species than a bootstrap
classifier at its threshold, trading recall for precision (OD 43). This
chapter measures both against the Species rank of the main grid (chapter 01,
the `Gen_sp` rows), with the same truth and the same scoring functions: a
dada2 column scored here alone gives the cached value of chapter 01.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/09_species_exact.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
source(here("R/mock_truth.R"))
source(here("R/score_assignments.R"))
source(here("R/assignment_helpers.R"))
source(here("R/species_exact.R"))
source(here("R/species_scoring.R"))
source(here("R/autometric_helpers.R"))

exact_methods <- c("assignSpecies", "vsearch", "blastn")
method_levels <- unique(c(exact_methods, single_methods))
store_species <- here(if (analysis_mini) "store_species_mini" else "store_species")
species_queries <- tar_read(species_queries, store = store_species)
blastn_hits <- tar_read(species_blastn_all, store = store_species)
vsearch_near <- tar_read(species_vsearch_near_all, store = store_species)
calls <- species_calls(
  tar_read(species_assign_all, store = store_species),
  tar_read(species_vsearch_all, store = store_species),
  hits_at(blastn_hits, "exact"),
  queries = names(species_queries$seqs)
)
# vsearch and blastn at the three match levels (S6). Their exact level is
# the one of `calls` for blastn; for vsearch it comes from the near search,
# so it is kept aside from the exact search of S1 to S5.
calls_near <- near_calls(
  vsearch_near,
  blastn_hits,
  queries = names(species_queries$seqs)
)

# The inputs of the species store that have a truth (the mocks of chapter
# 01): one tab each.
species_views <- species_queries$map |>
  distinct(dataset, input) |>
  filter(dataset %in% analysis_datasets$dataset) |>
  mutate(
    region = sub("_.*$", "", input),
    unit = toupper(sub("^.*_", "", input)),
    region = factor(region, levels = c("ITS1", "ITS2", "full")),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = analysis_datasets$dataset)
  ) |>
  arrange(dataset, region, unit) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(dataset, region), as.character),
    id = paste0(dataset, "_", input),
    view = paste(dataset, region, unit)
  )
stopifnot(nrow(species_views) > 0)

# The truth of one input, as chapter 01 builds it: the ASVs from the DADA2
# store, the OTUs from their trimmed sequences.
truth_for <- function(dataset, input) {
  ds <- analysis_datasets[analysis_datasets$dataset == dataset, ]
  cfg <- mock_sanger_tables[mock_sanger_tables$dataset == dataset, ]
  physeq <- if (grepl("_asv$", input)) {
    tar_read(d_asv, store = ds$dada2_store)
  } else {
    tar_read_raw(paste0("d_", input, "_real"), store = ds$store)
  }
  build_mock_truth(physeq, cfg)
}

# One input scored: the exact-match columns (Species rows only, see
# add_exact_columns()) and everything the sections below need about it.
score_exact_input <- function(v) {
  ds <- analysis_datasets[analysis_datasets$dataset == v$dataset, ]
  physeq <- tar_read_raw(
    paste0("d_", v$input, "_for_assignation"),
    store = ds$store
  )
  map <- filter(species_queries$map, dataset == v$dataset, input == v$input)
  truth <- truth_for(v$dataset, v$input)
  external <- external_control_truth(taxa_names(physeq))
  added <- add_exact_columns(
    physeq,
    bind_rows(
      mutate(calls, match = "exact"),
      filter(calls_near, match != "exact")
    ),
    map,
    v$input
  )
  # Both truth rules, as the grid rows they are compared with (OD 44).
  res_rules <- score_truth_rules(
    added$physeq,
    added$ranks_df,
    truth,
    db_meta,
    external_truth = external,
    truth_ranks = truth_ranks
  ) |>
    filter(tax_level == "Species") |>
    mutate(
      tax_level = "Gen_sp",
      algo = sub("^.*_(assignSpecies|vsearch|blastn)__.*$", "\\1", method_db),
      db = assignment_db(method_db),
      match = names(match_tags)[match(sub("^.*___", "", method_db), match_tags)],
      approach = ifelse(match == "exact", "exact match", paste0("near: ", match))
    )
  list(
    view = v,
    res = keep_truth_rule(res_rules),
    res_rules = res_rules,
    truth = truth,
    map = map
  )
}
scored <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(species_views)), \(i) score_exact_input(species_views[i, ]))
names(scored) <- species_views$id

# The exact and near rows of every input, and the Species rows of the main
# grid for the same inputs (chapter 01): the four methods, every setting.
# Both truth rules in the `_rules` objects (Q2b section), the lead one in the
# others.
res_species_rules <- bind_rows(lapply(scored, function(s) {
  mutate(s$res_rules, dataset = s$view$dataset, input = s$view$input, view = s$view$view)
}))
res_species <- keep_truth_rule(res_species_rules)
res_exact <- filter(res_species, match == "exact")
res_grid_rules <- cache_read("res_comp_tax") |>
  filter(tax_level == "Gen_sp", !is_consensus, algo %in% single_methods) |>
  mutate(input = paste0(region, "_", tolower(unit))) |>
  inner_join(select(species_views, dataset, input, view), by = c("dataset", "input")) |>
  mutate(
    approach = case_when(
      algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax") ~ paste0("bootstrap ", bootstrap_num),
      algo == "lca" ~ paste0("lca cutoff ", lca_cutoff),
      TRUE ~ paste0(vote_algorithm, " ", min_id, " %")
    )
  )
res_grid <- keep_truth_rule(res_grid_rules)
res_grid_default <- filter_default_settings(res_grid) |>
  mutate(approach = "main grid, default")
res_both <- bind_rows(res_exact, res_grid_default) |>
  mutate(
    algo = factor(algo, levels = method_levels),
    db = factor(db, levels = db_list)
  )

# One panel-tabset with a tab per input; fun() must print() a figure before
# save_fig(), as in view_tabs().
species_tabs <- function(fun) {
  cat("\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (id in species_views$id) {
    cat("### ", species_views$view[species_views$id == id], "\n\n", sep = "")
    fun(scored[[id]], id)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Means over the nine databases, per input and method.
s09_means <- res_both |>
  filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "TPR", "TP", "FP")) |>
  group_by(view, approach, algo, metrics) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(named = TP + FP)
s09_exact <- filter(s09_means, approach == "exact match")
s09_default <- filter(s09_means, approach == "main grid, default")
# The three exact methods: the same call (a species or none) on every
# (query, db)? Their statuses may differ without consequence: assignSpecies
# cannot see the records that name no species.
s09_agree <- calls |>
  select(db, query, method, status, call) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = c(status, call)) |>
  mutate(
    same = coalesce(call_assignSpecies, "") == coalesce(call_vsearch, "") &
      coalesce(call_vsearch, "") == coalesce(call_blastn, ""),
    same_vsearch_blastn = status_vsearch == status_blastn
  )
s09_fake <- res_exact |>
  filter(metrics == "NA_fake") |>
  mutate(named = 1 - values)
s09_bootstrap_ppv <- filter(s09_default, algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax"))
# Near matches (S6): vsearch and blastn at each match level.
s09_near <- res_species |>
  filter(algo %in% c("vsearch", "blastn")) |>
  filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "TPR", "TP", "FP", "NA_fake")) |>
  group_by(view, match, algo, metrics) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(
    match = factor(match, levels = names(match_tags)),
    named = TP + FP,
    fake_named = 1 - NA_fake
  )
near_at <- \(m) filter(s09_near, match == m)
```

Datasets in the species store with a truth:
`r paste(unique(species_views$dataset), collapse = ", ")` (inputs:
`r paste(species_views$view, collapse = "; ")`). Means over the nine
databases; the main grid at its default settings (bootstrap 0.5).

- **The three exact methods give the same call** on `r sum(s09_agree$same)`
  of `r nrow(s09_agree)` (query, database) pairs; vsearch and blastn also
  agree on the status of `r sum(s09_agree$same_vsearch_blastn)`.
- **Precision**: exact matching reaches a PPV of
  `r fmt_range(s09_exact$PPV)` at Species, against
  `r fmt_range(s09_bootstrap_ppv$PPV)` for dada2 and sintax at bootstrap 0.5.
- **Recall**: it names `r fmt_range(s09_exact$named, 1)` real units per
  database, against `r fmt_range(s09_bootstrap_ppv$named, 1)` for dada2 and
  sintax; its TPR is `r fmt_range(s09_exact$TPR)` against
  `r fmt_range(s09_bootstrap_ppv$TPR)`, and its F1
  `r fmt_range(s09_exact$F1_score)` against
  `r fmt_range(s09_bootstrap_ppv$F1_score)`.
- **Shuffled controls named**: `r fmt_range(s09_fake$named)` by exact
  matching.
- **Loosening the match** (vsearch and blastn, S6): F1
  `r fmt_range(near_at("exact")$F1_score)` at exact match,
  `r fmt_range(near_at("1 difference")$F1_score)` with one difference
  allowed, `r fmt_range(near_at("90 % covered")$F1_score)` with 90 % of the
  query covered at 100 %; PPV `r fmt_range(near_at("exact")$PPV)`,
  `r fmt_range(near_at("1 difference")$PPV)` and
  `r fmt_range(near_at("90 % covered")$PPV)`.

## S1 — Agreement of the three exact methods

The three methods apply the same criterion through different searches:
assignSpecies scans every record naming a species, vsearch stops after 32
rejected candidates, blastn keeps 2 000 records per query. Number of queries
(distinct sequences of every input of the store, controls included) per
status, method and database.

```{r s1}
#| echo: false
calls |>
  count(db, method, status) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    db = factor(db, levels = db_list),
    method = factor(method, levels = exact_methods)
  ) |>
  arrange(db, method) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Queries per status of the species call (all queries of the species store).")
```

```{r s1-disagree}
#| echo: false
s09_disagree <- filter(s09_agree, !same | !same_vsearch_blastn)
if (nrow(s09_disagree) == 0) {
  cat("No (query, database) pair where the calls, or the vsearch and blastn statuses, differ.\n")
} else {
  s09_disagree |>
    select(db, query, starts_with("status_"), starts_with("call_")) |>
    knitr::kable(caption = "Pairs where the calls, or the vsearch and blastn statuses, differ.")
}
s09_capped <- blastn_hits |>
  filter(n_targets >= 2000) |>
  distinct(db, query)
```

blastn keeps 2 000 records per query; `r nrow(s09_capped)` (query, database)
pairs reach that cap, where a record beyond the 2 000th could be missing.

## S2 — Precision and recall against the main grid

Species (`Gen_sp`) scores of the exact-match columns beside the four methods
of the main grid at every setting (dada2 and sintax bootstrap 0.4, 0.5, 0.6;
lca cutoffs; blastn votes and identities). One point per database.

```{r s2, results = "asis"}
species_tabs(function(s, id) {
  rows <- bind_rows(
    filter(res_exact, view == s$view$view),
    filter(res_grid, view == s$view$view)
  ) |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("PPV", "TPR")) |>
    select(algo, approach, db, metrics, values) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = values) |>
    mutate(
      family = ifelse(approach == "exact match", "exact match", "main grid"),
      algo = factor(algo, levels = method_levels)
    ) |>
    # PPV is undefined for a column that names no unit.
    filter(!is.na(PPV), !is.na(TPR))
  fig_species_ppv_tpr <- rows |>
    ggplot(aes(x = TPR, y = PPV, colour = algo, shape = family)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("exact match" = 17, "main grid" = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      x = "TPR (truthed units named right)",
      y = "PPV (named units named right)",
      colour = "Method",
      shape = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
  print(fig_species_ppv_tpr)
  save_fig(fig_species_ppv_tpr, paste0("fig_species_ppv_tpr_", id), width = 8, height = 7)

  bind_rows(
    filter(res_exact, view == s$view$view),
    filter(res_grid_default, view == s$view$view)
  ) |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "TPR", "TP", "FP")) |>
    select(approach, algo, db, metrics, values) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = values) |>
    mutate(
      algo = factor(algo, levels = method_levels),
      db = factor(db, levels = db_list),
      across(c(F1_score, PPV, TPR), \(x) round(x, 3))
    ) |>
    arrange(db, algo) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Species: exact match and the main grid at default settings, per database.")
})
```

## S3 — Why exact matching names few species

Each real unit of the input with a species truth, against each database, by
what the exact search found for it (vsearch; the three methods give the same
calls, S1). "right species" counts the true binomial or its accepted name.
The second table reads, for the units not named right, the nearest record of
their own species among the near hits of blastn (S6): is the true species
one difference away, does its record hold at least 90 % of the query at 100 %
and simply stop early, or is it further?

```{r s3, results = "asis"}
species_tabs(function(s, id) {
  truthed <- s$truth |>
    filter(!is.na(Species), !foreign, taxon %in% s$map$taxon) |>
    select(taxon, Species, any_of("Species_accepted"))
  if (!"Species_accepted" %in% names(truthed)) {
    truthed$Species_accepted <- NA_character_
  }
  outcome <- calls |>
    filter(method == "vsearch") |>
    inner_join(s$map, by = "query", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    inner_join(truthed, by = "taxon") |>
    mutate(
      outcome = case_when(
        status == "one species" &
          (call == Species | call == coalesce(Species_accepted, "")) ~ "right species",
        status == "one species" ~ "wrong species",
        TRUE ~ as.character(status)
      ),
      outcome = factor(
        outcome,
        levels = c("right species", "wrong species", species_status_levels[-1])
      ),
      db = factor(db, levels = db_list)
    )
  fig_species_outcome <- outcome |>
    count(db, outcome) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db, y = n, fill = outcome)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Real units with a species truth", fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_species_outcome)
  save_fig(fig_species_outcome, paste0("fig_species_outcome_", id), width = 9, height = 6)
  outcome |>
    count(db, outcome) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    arrange(db) |>
    cat_kable(caption = paste0(
      "Real units of the input with a species truth (", nrow(truthed),
      "), by what vsearch found."
    ))

  # The nearest record of the unit's own species among the near hits of
  # blastn (at most one difference, or 90 % covered at 100 %).
  missed <- filter(outcome, outcome != "right species")
  own <- blastn_hits |>
    inner_join(s$map, by = "query", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    select(db, taxon, binomial, diffs, exact_cover)
  near <- missed |>
    mutate(db = as.character(db)) |>
    select(db, taxon, Species, Species_accepted) |>
    left_join(own, by = c("db", "taxon"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    mutate(
      own = !is.na(binomial) &
        (binomial == Species | binomial == coalesce(Species_accepted, ""))
    ) |>
    group_by(db, taxon) |>
    summarise(
      nearest = case_when(
        any(own & diffs <= 1) ~ "one difference",
        any(own & exact_cover) ~ "90 % covered, record stops early",
        TRUE ~ "further, or no record of its species"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(db = factor(db, levels = db_list))
  near |>
    count(db, nearest) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = nearest, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    arrange(db) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Units not named right: the nearest blastn record of their own species.")
})
```

## S4 — Controls

The shuffled controls (`fake_`) hold no real sequence, so an exact match on
one is an error by construction. `NA_fake` is the share of them left
unnamed; `ext_correct` and `ext_fungi` read the non-fungal `external_`
controls as in chapter 01.

```{r s4}
#| echo: false
res_both |>
  filter(metrics %in% c("NA_fake", "ext_correct", "ext_fungi")) |>
  group_by(view, approach, algo, metrics) |>
  summarise(value = round(mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metrics, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(view, approach, algo) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Controls at Species, mean over the nine databases.")
```

## S5 — Time and memory of the three methods

What each method costs to name species against each database, on the same
queries. Sources:

- **assignSpecies and vsearch**: the targets of the species project, one call
  per database on the distinct sequences of every input of the store pooled
  (autometric logs, `with_autometric()`); assignSpecies has no thread option
  and runs on one core, vsearch on `r assign_threads[["lca"]]`.
- **blastn**: its own search in the species project (since 2026-10-07), one
  call per database, `makeblastdb` included, on
  `r assign_threads[["blastn"]]` threads. It also gives the near matches of
  S6, so its cost covers both; blastn uses about one core whatever its
  thread count (its search is short, `makeblastdb` is single-threaded).
- **vsearch near search** (S6): shown in its own row, `vsearch (near)`.

Memory is the peak of the R worker **and its child processes** (vsearch,
BLAST+), sampled every second (`peak_tree_mb`, `R/sample_tree.R`). Runs
logged before the sampler (2026-10-07) only have the R process, which sits
idle while vsearch or BLAST+ work: their memory is shown as not measured.
CPU is the CPU time of the worker and of its children. Provisional, as every
cost before M2.4 (OD 31): the machine was not reserved for these runs.

```{r s5-data}
#| include: false
species_autometric <- here(
  "data/data_final/autometric",
  sub("^store_", "", basename(store_species))
)
# The newest run of each species target.
cost_methods <- c(
  assign = "assignSpecies",
  vsearch = "vsearch",
  blastn = "blastn",
  vsearch_near = "vsearch (near)"
)
s09_cost <- read_autometric_dir(species_autometric) |>
  summarise_autometric_costs() |>
  add_tree_costs(species_autometric) |>
  filter(grepl("^species_(assign|vsearch|vsearch_near|blastn)__", phase)) |>
  transmute(
    method = unname(cost_methods[sub("^species_(.*)__.*$", "\\1", phase)]),
    db = sub("^species_[a-z_]+__", "", phase),
    wall_s = coalesce(wall_s, wall_time_s),
    cpu_s = cpu_self_s + cpu_child_s,
    peak_mb = peak_tree_mb,
    threads = case_when(
      method == "assignSpecies" ~ 1L,
      method == "blastn" ~ as.integer(assign_threads[["blastn"]]),
      TRUE ~ as.integer(assign_threads[["lca"]])
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = cost_methods),
    db = factor(db, levels = db_list)
  ) |>
  arrange(method, db)
s09_cost_total <- s09_cost |>
  group_by(method) |>
  summarise(
    minutes = sum(wall_s) / 60,
    cpu_minutes = sum(cpu_s) / 60,
    peak_mb = max(peak_mb),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
fmt_mb <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "not measured", paste(format(round(x), big.mark = " "), "MB"))
}
```

Over the nine databases: assignSpecies
`r round(s09_cost_total$minutes[s09_cost_total$method == "assignSpecies"], 1)`
min, vsearch
`r round(s09_cost_total$minutes[s09_cost_total$method == "vsearch"], 1)` min,
blastn `r round(s09_cost_total$minutes[s09_cost_total$method == "blastn"], 1)`
min of wall time (exact and near matches; the near search of vsearch
`r round(s09_cost_total$minutes[s09_cost_total$method == "vsearch (near)"], 1)`
min more). Peak memory: assignSpecies
`r fmt_mb(s09_cost_total$peak_mb[s09_cost_total$method == "assignSpecies"])`,
vsearch
`r fmt_mb(s09_cost_total$peak_mb[s09_cost_total$method == "vsearch"])`,
blastn
`r fmt_mb(s09_cost_total$peak_mb[s09_cost_total$method == "blastn"])`.

```{r s5-fig}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
fig_species_cost <- s09_cost |>
  select(method, db, `Wall time (min)` = wall_s, `Peak memory (MB)` = peak_mb) |>
  mutate(`Wall time (min)` = `Wall time (min)` / 60) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(method, db), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = db, y = value, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Method") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_species_cost)
save_fig(fig_species_cost, "fig_species_cost", width = 12, height = 5)
```

```{r s5-table}
#| echo: false

  transmute(
    method,
    db,
    threads,
    minutes = round(wall_s / 60, 2),
    `CPU minutes` = round(cpu_s / 60, 2),
    `peak memory` = fmt_mb(peak_mb)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Time and memory per method and database, species project.")
```

## S6 — Near matches: one difference, or 90 % covered at 100 %

Does F1 rise much once the match is loosened (developer, 2026-10-07)?
vsearch and blastn at three match levels: **exact** (no difference over the
query), **1 difference** (one substitution, indel, ambiguity code of the
record, or query base beyond the end of the record), **90 % covered**
(100 % identity over at least 90 % of the query, the rest of the query lying
beyond an end of the record: the record stops early, it does not hold
different bases there). The same call rule (unanimity of the named hits) at each level;
dashed lines: dada2 and sintax of the main grid at bootstrap 0.5, mean over
the nine databases. One point per database.

```{r s6, results = "asis"}
species_tabs(function(s, id) {
  rows <- res_species |>
    filter(view == s$view$view, algo %in% c("vsearch", "blastn")) |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "TPR")) |>
    mutate(
      match = factor(match, levels = names(match_tags)),
      algo = factor(algo, levels = method_levels)
    )
  reference <- res_grid_default |>
    filter(view == s$view$view, algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax")) |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "PPV", "TPR")) |>
    group_by(algo, metrics) |>
    summarise(values = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(algo = factor(algo, levels = method_levels))
  fig_species_near <- rows |>
    ggplot(aes(x = match, y = values, colour = algo)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = reference,
      aes(yintercept = values, colour = algo),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), alpha = 0.75) +
    facet_wrap(~metrics) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Method") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_species_near)
  save_fig(fig_species_near, paste0("fig_species_near_", id), width = 10, height = 5)

  s09_near |>
    filter(view == s$view$view) |>
    transmute(
      match,
      method = factor(algo, levels = method_levels),
      named = round(named, 1),
      F1 = round(F1_score, 3),
      PPV = round(PPV, 3),
      TPR = round(TPR, 3),
      `shuffled controls named` = round(fake_named, 3)
    ) |>
    arrange(match, method) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Near matches, mean over the nine databases (named: real units given a species).")
})
```

```{r s6-agree}
#| echo: false
calls_near |>
  select(db, query, method, match, call) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = call) |>
  group_by(match) |>
  summarise(
    pairs = n(),
    `same call` = sum(coalesce(vsearch, "") == coalesce(blastn, "")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "vsearch and blastn: (query, database) pairs with the same call, per match level.")
```

## Under Q2b (OD 44)

Every section above reads the lead truth rule, `no_truth_aside`: the real
units without a truth (best hit 90–99.5 % to a mock member) leave the
scoring, so the chapter measures the assignment step, not how well the
sequencing represents the community. Under `q2b` they stay in it, wrong when
named and missed when left NA (chapter 01, OD 44).

```{r q2b-data}
#| include: false
# Exact matching (mean of its three methods) against dada2 and sintax at
# bootstrap 0.5, per input, under each truth rule; means over the databases.
s09_rule_means <- function(rule, metric) {
  bind_rows(
    keep_truth_rule(res_species_rules, rule) |>
      filter(match == "exact") |>
      mutate(approach = "exact match"),
    keep_truth_rule(res_grid_rules, rule) |>
      filter_default_settings() |>
      filter(algo %in% c("dada2", "sintax")) |>
      mutate(approach = "dada2 and sintax, bootstrap 0.5")
  ) |>
    filter(metrics == metric) |>
    group_by(view, approach) |>
    summarise(value = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}
s09_rules_ppv <- compare_truth_rules(\(rule) s09_rule_means(rule, "PPV"), "approach")
s09_rules_f1 <- compare_truth_rules(\(rule) s09_rule_means(rule, "F1_score"), "approach")
```

Which approach has the higher Species PPV `r rule_holds_phrase(s09_rules_ppv)`;
which has the higher F1 `r rule_holds_phrase(s09_rules_f1)`.

```{r q2b-table}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(
  bind_rows(
    mutate(s09_rules_ppv$table, metric = "PPV"),
    mutate(s09_rules_f1$table, metric = "F1")
  ) |>
    relocate(metric),
  caption = "Species PPV and F1, mean over the nine databases: no_truth_aside / q2b."
)
```
